name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site roots, certificates, security hardening, Fail2ban, firewall rules, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis logging storage, authentication, service enablement, and a post-configuration compatibility workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a Git checkout, virtual environment, application dependencies, database credentials, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
